Flat6Labs - Flat6Labs Ignite Flat6Labs Ignite - Flat6Labs ACCELERATING THE FUTURE ACCELERATING THE FUTURE Programs arrow_drop_down Programs for Entrepreneurs Programs for Entrepreneur Support Organizations (ESOs) Advisory Insights English العربية Français close Programs Programs for Entrepreneurs Programs for Entrepreneur Support Organizations (ESOs) Advisory About Flat6Labs Become Our Community Partner Apply Now Our Team Insights Reports Press FAQs Jobs Contact Us apply now Flat6Labs Ignite Flat6Labs has partnered with ADQ, one of MENA’s largest holding companies, for the launch of a seed and early stage funding opportunity for startups; the ‘Flat6Labs Ignite’ Program. The UAE has solidified its presence as a leading technology hub for startups in the region, accounting for an average of 60% of total MENA annual investments as well as 40% of the region’s top exits. Not only that, the UAE is also ranked 16th globally in the World Bank’s ‘Ease of Doing Business’ report. For all that and more, we are excited that UAE’s capital city Abu Dhabi will be the landing ground for our leading seed program ‘Flat6Labs Ignite’ to foster innovation in the UAE, the region and the globe with technology and entrepreneurship as the central themes. Funded by Tech Accelerator Fund WHAT TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING Once you are selected to join the Flat6Labs Ignite Program, you receive cash-funding

Funded by Tech Accelerator Fund WHAT TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING Once you are selected to join the Flat6Labs Ignite Program, you receive cash-funding ($150K-$250K), strategic mentorship, office-space, entrepreneurship-focused business training, subject matter one to one sessions and a multitude of perks and services from our partners.
One or more founders must be available in Abu Dhabi for at least the duration of the program (Unless the program is run virtually).
You must be committed to establish a long term presence in Abu Dhabi.
Selection Bootcamp The selection bootcamp will gather 15-20 teams filtered from the initial interview phase, and will see the teams engage with different stakeholders.
The teams will receive the bootcamp training curriculum that consists of world-class mentorship and coaching.
The bootcamp could be viewed as a condensed version of our seed program.

Selection Committee Based on the startups’ performance during the Bootcamp, the best teams get to present in front of our panel of esteemed guests, industry experts, mentors, and entrepreneurs who make up our seed program selection committee.
The selection committee then decides which teams should be finally admitted into the seed program.

Demo Day The Demo Day is a celebration of what the startup teams have achieved during the seed program cycle - it’s where they get the opportunity to pitch in front of a large and engaged audience filled with international and regional investors from the Flat6Labs network who are ready to fund the next big thing.
In addition to that, the sheer amount of marketing Demo Day provides for a company is unparalleled which can act as a launching pad for our startups.
Support and Monitoring Graduating from the seed program cycle does not mean the end of your relationship with Flat6Labs.
After Demo Day, our team continues to follow-up with you on a regular basis to provide you with all the support and resources you need to scale and secure follow-on funding.
